The '''Direllia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Nembus sector/Legends|Nembus sector]], within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system was the origin point of the [[Direllian Plague]].<ref name="Journal1">{{JournalCite|1|The Quality of Mercy}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Direllian Plague]]|system=Direllia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Direllia system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square P-4.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
